# Official baseline files

This folder contains the Task 1 and Task 2 baseline/evaluator files copied from
the official [TrafficFlowBench public repository](https://github.com/jacky850/trafficflowbench-public).
The copied Python source is unchanged. The original MIT license is included in
this folder. These files were copied from upstream commit
`24c4bddc1a353e2e0ad3e2a6679eb5960377a622`. Keep this attribution if these
files are moved or reused.

The competition data itself belongs under `../../data/kaggle_public/` and is
excluded from Git by the project `.gitignore`.
